scope: The four tooling gaps raised after the browser build. Each entry states the gap, the verdict, and the command output that justifies it.

attachRun.note: Reuses a live headless editor instead of paying the engine startup twice.

negativeControl.method: Copy voxel_data.gd, inject `var _injected_type_error: int = "not an int"`, check only that file.

_gdcheck_probe.gd:4:33 error Cannot assign a value of type String to variable "_injected_type_error" with specified type int.

gaps.notUsed: The Godot MCP `scripts` toolset would wrap the same language server but needs the editor addon bridge (ws://127.0.0.1:9080), which is offline unless the project runs the addon. The built-in LSP is the same data with one less moving part.
gaps.rejected: A `--no-lsp` fallback using `godot --check-only --script` was implemented, measured, and removed: it reports a bogus `Class "X" hides a global script class` error for every script that declares `class_name` (4 of the 9 voxel scripts).

jumpCaptured130msLater.discrepancy: Tesseract read the 5 as a 3; the crop in hud-jump-compare.png shows 5.0.

designNotes: PrintWindow with PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT is required for a swap-chain window; a plain BitBlt returns black.
The process is made per-monitor DPI aware before any coordinate is read.
Focus uses AttachThreadInput because Windows blocks SetForegroundWindow from a background process.
Window lookup accepts --pid, because a Chrome tab titled after the game matched the same title substring and was larger than the game window.

subcommands: analyze: mean/std RGB, 4-bit distinct colours, non-black fraction, dominant colours by share
diff: changed pixel count and fraction, mean and max absolute difference, bounding box of change
bands: locate horizontal text rows by luminance or edge energy, so a HUD line can be cropped exactly
ocr: Tesseract over a region with optional scale, PSM and character whitelist
limits: OCR is reliable for labels and line structure, not for single glyphs: the player Y coordinate read 5.0 as 3.0 at scales 4, 6 and 8, and at PSM 6, 7 and 8.
Thresholding the crop and restricting the whitelist to digits made the digits worse, not better; both were tested and not shipped as defaults.
A value that matters should be confirmed against the crop, `analyze` or `diff`, not a single OCR pass.

gaps.boundary: controller/startup-diagnostics.mjs classifies a startup failure after the fact from collected output. supervise.mjs streams a running process and reports hangs; it reuses collectEngineErrors for the final classification.

verified.observed: code 3, stderr line captured, class failed
engineErrors populated from `SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: boom`
hang event at 625 ms, timeout at 2500 ms, code 124
4 startup lines streamed, timeout kill at 3000 ms, code 124
engine banner streamed, code 0 in 1376 ms

designNotes: Hang detection is silence-based and off by default, because an idle server is silent and healthy.
Exit codes mirror the child, plus 124 for a timeout and 125 for a spawn failure.

tests/supervise.test.mjs (7 cases: clean, failing, engine error, hang, clock reset, spawn failure, empty command)
